## Overview

### Why

At the homepage hero's size at 2x, Aurora took 14.4 ms of GPU time a frame, against a 4 ms limit. Each of its 60 march steps worked out a five-octave field for every pixel, though the field depends only on a point on the sky plane.

### Behavior change

Aurora draws its field into a texture once a frame, and each march step reads the texture. At 2x, a frame takes about 5 ms of GPU time instead of 14.4 ms. The pull request regenerates Aurora's visual-regression baselines and posters.

### Checks

- Aurora's regenerated baselines.
- A new visual check that fails when a row of the canvas comes out flat, which is how a broken field pass draws.

### Not covered

At 5 ms a frame, Aurora still misses the 4 ms limit.

## Regenerate Aurora's baselines

The default story's screenshot changes, so the pull request regenerates its baselines. A baseline regenerated from a broken field would pass its own screenshot, so a new check fails when a row of the canvas comes out flat.
